race.comment: THIS IS THE DAY (5) led for home but was gone soon after over 1100m at Strathalbyn last start. Given a five-week freshen-up since that appearance. Faces by far the weakest race of his three so far. Should be hard to roll. SAUNTERING (4) returns after a 193-day spell. Raced three times in the maiden prep, with a 2.3-length fifth over 1200m at Balaklava the highlight. Strong contender if he found that form. UNCOMMON MIND (11) last raced 11 months ago. Finished second over 1075m at Penola last prep which is strong form for a race like this. Should go fast and take some catching. GOLDEN BASILICA (8) is a St Mark's Basilica three-year-old on debut. Placed at the last three jump-outs which is encouraging. Betting the key. VASILIAS (7) comes here off a six-week freshen-up and is third-up. Placed at his only other run at this stage of the prep. Keep in mind.
